proof: `ASSESSMENT HISTORY / 1998-2017`, PDF page 149 of the FY2017 annual town report -- the Montachusett Regional Vocational Technical School District's assessment on each of its 18 member towns, for 20 school years. A STATE/REGIONAL DOCUMENT REPRODUCED IN THE TOWN REPORT: the publisher is Monty Tech, not Lunenburg. THE PAGE IS LANDSCAPE, PRINTED SIDEWAYS, AND ITS TEXT LAYER IS MIRRORED -- every word arrives with its characters reversed (`YROTSIH TNEMSSESSA`, `GRUBNENUL`, `LATOT`), the FY2014 defect recorded in notes/process/READING-A-REPORT-PAGE.md. Reversing each word recovers it exactly; the LAYOUT is not mirrored, so a constant-top band in the file is a COLUMN on the page and x increases down the page's rows. THE PRINTED HEADER, read off the rendered page left to right: `SCHOOL YEAR | ASHBY | BARRE | FITCHBURG | GARDNER | HARVARD | HUBBARDSTON | LUNENBURG | ROYALSTON | STERLING | WINCHENDON | ASHBURNHAM | ATHOL | PETERSHAM | PHILLIPSTON | PRINCETON | TEMPLETON | WESTMINSTER | HOLDEN | TOTAL | % CHANGE`. ROWS ARE PLACED BY COLUMN POSITION AND NOT BY ORDER: the row ruler is the SCHOOL YEAR column's own 20 labels, measured pitch 12.791pt, band half of that, and no figure on the page is unplaced. HOLDEN prints 18 values, not 20 -- it is BLANK for 1999-2000 and 1998-1999 -- and an absent column stays absent rather than shifting its neighbours. FOUR INDEPENDENT PROOFS. (1) The 18 town figures sum to the printed TOTAL in all 20 years, within the declared tolerance; 8 of the 20 close EXACTLY and the largest residual is $3. (2) All 19 printed % CHANGE values reproduce from the TOTAL column as (TOTAL_n - TOTAL_n+1)/TOTAL_n+1, to better than 0.005 percentage points, which proves both the TOTAL column and the row ORDER. (3) The same report prints this TOTAL series twice more and both agree exactly: page 142's `Community Assessments` row gives 8,682,724 / 9,441,464 / 10,039,328 / 10,120,930 / 10,314,076 for 13-14 to 17-18 with the same 1.91% change, and page 141's `TOTAL ASSESSMENT (All Budgets)` gives $10,120,930 and $10,314,076. (4) Page 148, COMMUNITY ASSESSMENTS, prints this page's two most recent columns per town: all 19 values of `APPROVED ASSESSMENT FY'2018` and all 19 of `APPROVED ASSESSMENT FY2017` -- 38 figures -- agree with this reading EXACTLY, and page 148 is a PHOTOGRAPH read by eye while this one is a text layer, so the two readings are independent. EVERY MONEY FIGURE ON THIS PAGE IS A WHOLE-DOLLAR DISPLAY OF AN AMOUNT THAT CARRIES CENTS, so a printed total is the rounded TRUE sum and not the sum of the rounded parts. A sum of n such displays can therefore miss its printed total by up to n/2 dollars; the widest sum here has 18 addends, so the DECLARED TOLERANCE IS $9 -- derived from the page's own precision, not fitted to the residuals, which never exceed $3. WHAT ESTABLISHES ROUNDING RATHER THAN A MISREAD is the one column that carries no cents: FOUNDATION ENROLLMENT on page 148 is a COUNT, and its 18 values tie to the printed Total 1,496 EXACTLY, while every money column beside it misses by 1 or 2. On page 149 the same contrast appears as 19 of 19 printed % CHANGE values reproducing from the TOTAL column to four decimal places while the 18 town figures miss their own printed total by at most $3.
